name: cycle
description: Two-year election cycle during which the contribution was recorded
observations: Partition column. Cycles are even years; the 1980 cycle covers 1979-1980

name: transaction_id
description: Unique identifier of the contribution record, assigned by DIME
observations: Primary key within a cycle

name: contributor_id
description: Unique identifier of the contributor, assigned by DIME entity resolution
observations: Stable across election cycles and levels of government; joins to the contributor table

name: recipient_id
description: Unique identifier of the recipient candidate or committee, assigned by DIME
observations: Stable across cycles, offices and levels of government; joins to the recipient table

name: efec_transaction_id_original
description: Original transaction identifier from the FEC electronic filing
observations: Empty for state and local records

name: efec_committee_id_original
description: Original committee identifier from the FEC electronic filing
observations: Empty for state and local records

name: back_reference_transaction_id
description: Identifier of an earlier record in the database that this record repeats
observations: Points at transaction_id; use it to drop duplicate entries

name: date
description: Date on which the contribution was transacted

name: amount
description: Dollar amount of the contribution
observations: Nominal dollars, not adjusted for inflation. Negative values occur on refunds and corrections

name: transaction_type
description: FEC code for the type of transaction
observations: Non-FEC codes 15S, 15L, 15PD, PF and PFR are assigned by DIME for state and local records

name: election_type
description: Type of election the contribution was made for

name: seat
description: Elected office sought by the recipient
observations: Readable labels of the form level:office, for example federal:house or state:lower. Offices prefixed 'local:' are not standardized, so the value space is open-ended (139 distinct values observed)

name: contributor_name
description: Full name of the contributor, cleaned and standardized by DIME
observations: Last name first; suffix and title removed

name: contributor_last_name
description: Last name of the contributor
observations: Empty for committees and organizations

name: contributor_first_name
description: First name of the contributor
observations: Empty for committees and organizations

name: contributor_middle_name
description: Middle name or initial of the contributor

name: contributor_suffix
description: Name suffix of the contributor
observations: For example Jr., Sr., III

name: contributor_title
description: Title of the contributor
observations: For example Mr., Mrs., Dr., Esq.

name: contributor_full_first_name
description: First name, middle name, suffix and title of the contributor concatenated

name: contributor_type
description: Whether the contributor is an individual or an organization

name: contributor_gender
description: Gender of the contributor
observations: Imputed by DIME from first-name gender ratios reported by the U.S. Census and from gendered titles; not self-reported

name: contributor_address
description: Street address reported by the contributor

name: contributor_city
description: City reported by the contributor

name: contributor_state
description: Two-letter state abbreviation reported by the contributor
observations: Includes territories and foreign codes, so it is not restricted to the 50 states plus DC and is not linked to the state directory

name: contributor_zipcode
description: ZIP code reported by the contributor
observations: Five or nine digits depending on the filing

name: contributor_district
description: Congressional district the contributor's geocode falls in
observations: Two-letter state abbreviation followed by the district number. District boundaries are those in force for the cycle, so the code is not comparable across redistricting cycles

name: census_tract_id
description: Census tract the contributor's geocode falls in
observations: Eleven-digit GEOID. Tract vintage follows the decennial boundaries in force for the cycle, so it is not linked to a single-vintage census tract directory

name: latitude
description: Latitude of the contributor's geocoded address
observations: Geocoded with the Pelias geocoder; consistent per contributor_id across records with varying address completeness

name: longitude
description: Longitude of the contributor's geocoded address
observations: Geocoded with the Pelias geocoder

name: gis_confidence
description: Confidence in the accuracy of the geocoded coordinates, from 0 to 1

name: contributor_occupation
description: Occupation reported by the contributor
observations: Cleaned and standardized by DIME

name: contributor_employer
description: Employer reported by the contributor
observations: Cleaned and standardized by DIME

name: occupation_standardized
description: Industry category the reported occupation was mapped to
observations: Assigned by DIME; populated for a minority of records

name: is_corporation
description: Whether the contributing committee is a corporation or trade organization
observations: Applies to committees only; these donors are excluded from the CFscore estimation

name: recipient_name
description: Name of the recipient candidate or committee

name: recipient_party
description: Party of the recipient
observations: Match against the recipient table for more detailed party codings

name: recipient_type
description: Whether the recipient is a candidate or a committee

name: recipient_state
description: Two-letter state abbreviation of the recipient
observations: Not linked to the state directory because it includes non-state codes

name: contributor_cfscore
description: Common-space CFscore of the contributor
observations: Ideal point estimated from the contributor's giving; negative is liberal, positive is conservative. Repeated on every record of the same contributor

name: candidate_cfscore
description: Common-space CFscore of the recipient
observations: Ideal point estimated from the donations the recipient received; negative is liberal, positive is conservative

name: excluded_from_scaling
description: Whether the record was excluded from the CFscore estimation
observations: Stored as 0 or 1 in the source

name: efec_memo
description: Memo field from the FEC electronic filing

name: efec_memo2
description: Auxiliary memo field from the FEC electronic filing

name: efec_organization_original
description: Original recipient name from the FEC electronic filing

name: efec_form_type
description: Form type of the FEC electronic filing the record came from
